reason: P07-03 adds a separate single-firm operator host with isolated Identity database/cookies/keys/MFA, marker-checked restricted billing role, transaction/idempotency/version/atomic correction endpoints, actual React forms and separate Docker/Compose packaging. Four real PostgreSQL SubscriptionOperator tests cover auth/MFA/recovery/stamp/CSRF, restricted grants and wrong markers/roles, exact retries/concurrent balance/rollback and all other firm tables unchanged. Existing Subscription/SubscriptionLedger classes preserve Owner read privacy and DB constraints. Operator UI/API tests cover MFA gating, unknown network result replay, 409 reload and unsaved/empty/error states; money and Services tests cover the explicitly wider subscription decimal input while preserving the service parser default and callers. CI scope/format/locked restore plus both frontend modes, operator image packaging, related normal Compose, isolated TLS/browser/restart/data/rollback and backed-up main8080 acceptance are required. Owner UI and the newly approved next-day automatic restriction/reopening remain dependent P07-04/05, not activated by this operator slice. No real accounts/payments/messages or public VPS deployment.
